source: User mandate (2026-08-07): click-driven, as-the-user, full end-to-end Playwright testing MUST be a hard loop-exit / completion-gate criterion for any frontend-impacting change; commits are landing untested because the v3.44.0 frontend_impact_e2e_review is per-task + escapable via a self-authored note, with no run-level completion-audit backstop.

baseline.note: zero NEW failures is the gate; +N added tests expected; check_separation unaffected (hooks tier, no new services module)

entries.spec_requirement_id: frontend-e2e-loop-exit-gate/A frontend-impacting run cannot complete without genuine passing E2E evidence
acceptance_criteria: _audit_frontend_e2e in pipeline-completion-audit.py aggregates files_changed across .architect-team/reviews/*.json + runs changed_files_touch_frontend; a frontend slice with no passing .architect-team/frontend-e2e/<slice>-verdict.json BLOCKS (test)
a passing verdict (verdict=passed, executed_against_live_env, >=1 user_driven_actions, existing trace_path, >=1 visible_state_assertions) -> zero violations (test)
a run touching no frontend -> no-op; CT6_FRONTEND_E2E_GATE_DISABLED -> no-op; fail-open outside an active run (test); registered in audit()

entries.spec_requirement_id: frontend-e2e-loop-exit-gate/A Layer-3 verifier validates that E2E evidence is genuine as-the-user testing
acceptance_criteria: verify-frontend-e2e-loop-exit in hooks/vao/ + re-exported through hooks/vao_tools.py (CLI byte-stable, --artifact/--out); Layer-3 tool count 21 -> 22 (pins moved)
bites on the four escape modes with distinct gaps: e2e-described-not-executed, e2e-api-only-no-user-actions, e2e-vacuous-navigate-assert, e2e-trace-claimed-but-absent (red fixture each)
a genuine click-driven artifact (real user actions + existing trace + visible-state assertion) -> valid:true, 0 gaps (green fixture); deterministic + stdlib-only

entries.spec_requirement_id: frontend-e2e-loop-exit-gate/A frontend UI change cannot self-authorize away the E2E gate
acceptance_criteria: review_evidence_schema.py keeps frontend_impact_e2e_review conditionally required on frontend-touching files_changed; the note-escape documented as no-runnable-UI-surface-only; the run-level arm is the backstop (test the conditional still fires)
wired into skills/architect-team-pipeline (Phase 3/5/8), skills/playwright-user-flows, docs/ETHOS.md; compiled boilerplate in sync; instruction-compliance 0 findings; no ': ' in frontmatter
full suite zero NEW failures vs baseline 6982/0/6 both encodings; check_separation green (unchanged, 26); check-can-fail verdict for the new test file(s); a demo captured

version 3.55.0 both plugin JSONs + dispatch-banner pin lockstep; CHANGELOG rubric entry; README spotlight-swap + RELEASE_HISTORY append + timeline; CLAUDE/CODEBASE_MAP/INTEGRATION_MAP/CAPABILITY_INDEX current (Layer-3 tools 21->22); completion audit exit 0

testing_authorizations.playwright: n/a - the deliverable is the ENFORCEMENT machinery (a completion-audit arm + a Layer-3 verifier + a schema hardening) that gates on the EXISTENCE + GENUINENESS of an E2E verdict artifact; it does not itself run a browser. Behavior verified by pytest over fixture verdict artifacts (genuine + each of the four escape modes) + the arm's block/no-op/kill-switch paths + a captured demo. The actual Playwright execution is the frontend/integration agent's job downstream; this run makes its absence a hard blocker.
testing_authorizations.dev_api_integration: n/a - the arm + verifier read local JSON verdict artifacts; no HTTP API.
testing_authorizations.both_layer_integration: n/a - all entries layer infra (the plugin's own discipline stack).
